name: MonarchAvailabilityToggle
title: AvailabilityToggle
summary: An on and off switch for whether automatic assignment may give someone new work: a status word with a mark, an optional hint and a Material 3 Switch, as one row.
whenToUse: Where work is assigned automatically (round robin, load balancing) and people must be able to step out of it: an account menu, a navigation drawer or a home screen.
whenNotToUse: For a chat-style presence with custom statuses use a status picker. For a setting saved with a form use MonarchSwitchRow inside the form.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchAvailabilityToggle(available: Boolean, onAvailableChange: (Boolean) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, enabled: Boolean = true, pending: Boolean = false, showHint: Boolean = false, labels: MonarchAvailabilityToggleLabels = MonarchAvailabilityToggleLabels(), interactionSource: MutableInteractionSource? = null)

@Immutable public class MonarchAvailabilityToggleLabels(public val label: String? = null, public val available: String? = null, public val away: String? = null, public val availableHint: String? = null, public val awayHint: String? = null, public val pending: String? = null)

options.name: available
options.description: Whether the person is available for new work.

options.name: onAvailableChange
options.description: Called with the new value when the person toggles the row. Update optimistically and roll back if saving fails.

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the person may change it; false when they have no permission to.

options.name: pending
options.description: A change is being saved: the switch cannot be toggled, a small progress ring is shown and TalkBack adds "Saving" to the state.

options.name: showHint
options.description: Shows one line under the status word that says what being available or away changes.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: label ("Available for new work"), available ("Available"), away ("Away"), availableHint, awayHint and pending ("Saving").

options.name: interactionSource
options.description: The interaction source of the row.

states.name: available
states.description: Switch on; a filled dot in the solid success color and the word "Available".

states.name: away
states.description: Switch off; a ring in the solid warning color and the word "Away".

states.name: pending
states.description: The switch is disabled, a progress ring precedes it and the state reads "Available, Saving" or "Away, Saving". The ring is still when animations are off.

states.name: disabled
states.description: The switch is disabled and the text uses the disabled color; announced as disabled.

states.name: focused
states.description: The focus ring around the row.

appearance: The mark uses the solid success color (available) or the solid warning color (away) in every theme, and differs in shape as well: a filled dot or a ring. The status word uses the default text color and the hint the muted text color; the switch is the Material 3 Switch in Monarch's accent colors. Light, dark and both high-contrast themes change only the roles.
platformNotes: The web renders nothing while the value is null; on Android the value is a Boolean and the app shows the toggle once it is known. The web's inMenu flag stops key events reaching a surrounding menu and has no meaning in Compose. The mark's filled and ring shapes, used on the web only in forced-colors mode, are always used here, as on iOS. A progress ring is shown while pending, as on iOS; the web only disables the switch. The built-in strings are one MonarchAvailabilityToggleLabels value instead of iOS's separate parameters, as Monarch for Android does for every component with several strings; the names match iOS (label, available, away, availableHint, awayHint, pending).
accessibility: The row is one TalkBack element with the switch role and the on or off toggle state; the whole row is the touch target and is at least 48dp high.
Its name is "Available for new work" (or labels.label); its state description is the visible status word, "Available" or "Away", so the state is read in the words that are shown.
The status word and the mark are not read a second time; the mark is decorative and differs in shape as well as color.
With showHint the hint is merged into the row and read after the name.
While pending the row is disabled and the state reads "Available, Saving"; the progress ring is hidden from TalkBack.
The text wraps at font scale 2.0 and the switch stays at the end; in a right-to-left layout the text is on the right and the switch on the left.
edgeCases: Long status words and hints wrap; the switch keeps its size.
A tap while pending is ignored, so a second change cannot start before the first is saved.
The app must show its own error (a snackbar) and roll back the value when saving fails; the toggle only reports the new value.

examples.title: With a hint
examples.template:
MonarchAvailabilityToggle(
    available = available,
    onAvailableChange = { available = it },
    showHint = {{showHint}},
)
examples.code:
MonarchAvailabilityToggle(
    available = available,
    onAvailableChange = { available = it },
    showHint = true,
)

examples.title: Saving the change before it shows
examples.setup:
var saved by remember { mutableStateOf(false) }
var requested by remember { mutableStateOf<Boolean?>(null) }
